cards.front: Define the convolution (f ∗ g)(t) for functions on [0, ∞).
cards.back: $(f ∗ g)(t) = \int_0^t f(\tau) g(t-\tau) \, d\tau$ (with f,g extended by 0 for t<0).

cards.front: State the Convolution Theorem for Laplace transforms.
How is the inverse Laplace transform of a product obtained via convolution?
Sketch the proof that $\mathcal{L}\{f ∗ g\} = F(s)G(s)$.
cards.back: Write double integral $\int_0^\infty e^{-st}\int_0^t f(\tau)g(t-\tau)d\tau dt$. Change order of integration over 0<τ<t<∞, substitute u=t-τ in inner integral to obtain F(s)G(s).

cards.front: State Duhamel's formula for the IVP $y''+p y'+q y = f(t)$, zero initial conditions.
cards.back: Let $w(t)$ be the solution for $f=\delta(t)$ (impulse response). Then $y(t)=(w ∗ f)(t)$.

cards.front: Name three algebraic properties of convolution useful for ODEs.
cards.back: Commutative ($f∗g=g∗f$), associative, distributive over addition; Laplace converts each to ordinary multiplication.
